name: Pacific Medical Prosthetics & Orthotics
old_description: Delivering Better Orthopedic Outcomes—One Patient, One Provider at a Time.
about:
Pacific Medical, Inc. was founded in 1987 by John Petlansky and is headquartered in Tracy, California. The company began as a durable medical equipment distributor serving eight western states and has since expanded its footprint across 18 states.

The company operates 15 orthotic and prosthetic patient care facilities and 40 satellite offices, supported by more than 200 internal staff and an external sales and service force of over 215 professionals. Its divisions include OrthoLIFE, a proprietary patient-centered orthopedic rehabilitation platform; a Surgical Division providing innovative solutions for orthopedic and surgical care; a Biologics Division delivering advanced regenerative products; and Top Shelf Orthopedics supporting product design, management, and distribution.

Pacific Medical serves healthcare providers and patients in the orthopedic rehabilitation, arthroscopic surgery, sports medicine, prosthetics, and orthotics markets. The company reports serving 540,000 lives annually through its network of hospitals and clinics across the western United States.

The company emphasizes innovation with integrity and partnerships with purpose, positioning its OrthoLIFE platform as a tailored DME solution that streamlines care and improves outcomes. Its biologics division focuses on regenerative products that promote healing, while its dedicated team of over 400 professionals acts as a trusted extension of partner practices.
